summary: Build practical IFRS 17 measurement, CSM, transition, disclosure, and data control skills through applied insurer workshops. Enrol today.
lede: IFRS 17 training helps insurance finance managers, actuaries, and reporting specialists connect insurance contract measurement with controlled financial reporting. Participants examine contract grouping and model eligibility, fulfilment cash flows, discount rates, risk adjustment, and contractual service margin movements across the General Measurement Model, Variable Fee Approach, and Premium Allocation Approach. They also practise data lineage, reconciliations, transition decisions, disclosure preparation, and control testing to support consistent reporting outputs.
audienceIntro: IFRS 17 training suits professionals who connect insurance contract measurement with financial reporting, governance, assurance, and implementation delivery. It is appropriate for intermediate practitioners who have exposure to insurance products, month-end reporting, actuarial results, or control testing.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to insurance finance, actuarial reporting, insurance products, financial close, risk management, internal audit, or implementation governance. Prior IFRS 17 experience is useful but not essential. No coding or programming is required. Advanced digital analytics and AI-assisted validation are introduced at conceptual and operational application level, not software engineering level. A laptop is recommended for workbook and dashboard exercises.
